text:
Liam O'Connor: Legal called out the line in our SOC2 guidance that reads 'we keep audit logs for 7 years' 5. We need softer language and a short 'evidence export' how-to. See draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/docs/pull/1438

Priya Desai: Agreed. Proposal: separate 'operational telemetry' vs 'evidence exports'. Example phrasing: 'Operational telemetry is retained by default for short-term service health (90 days). Customers can export audit artifacts for long-term compliance retention; we recommend retaining exported evidence for a minimum of 3 years (industry specific needs may require 6-7 years).'

Legal Bot: Approved framing. Avoid absolutes. Use 'recommend' and 'exportable' not 'we will retain'. Add parenthetical for regulated industries.

Priya Desai: I'll add two minimal SDK snippets: curl and Python v2. Curl example should show Authorization header and retention_metadata. Python snippet: a compact call to audit.exports.create(...) returning a download_url. Also include a tiny JSON redaction example: {"event":"user.create","user":"REDACTED","ip":"REDACTED","meta":{"exported_by":"team-ops"}}

SDK Bot: Suggested Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.audit.exports.create(start='2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', end='2025-12-31T23:59:59Z', retention_metadata={'retain_until':'2031-01-01T00:00:00Z','exported_by':'team-ops'})
print(resp.download_url)
```

Liam O'Connor: Nice. Also add a one-line KMS distinction: 'Hosted: data encrypted in transit and at rest; key management handled by Redwood. Private: supports customer KMS/HSM integrations.' Keep it concise.

Docs Bot: Reminder: fix the link anchor in docs/security/audit.md (it points to #retention-periods but heading is 'Retention guidance'). Add changelog entry under docs/whats-new.

Priya Desai: I'll update the PR with wording, both snippets, the redaction example, and the KMS sentence, then ping Legal for final read. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
